raw_definitions: Definisi : no ~er said than done, belum habis sebut sudah + approp v: “Goodness, have they delivered the pizza already?” “Yes, no ~er said than done”, “Alamak, mereka sudah hantar piza?” “Yalah, belum habis sebut sudah sampai”; “Would you hand me the paper?” “No ~er said than done”, “Tolong hulurkan kertas itu kpd saya.” “Belum habis sebut sudah buat”. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : no ~er, sebaik saja: no ~er had he bought it than he changed his mind, sebaik saja dia membelinya dia berubah fikiran; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : how ~?, berapa cepat: how ~ can the goods be sent?, berapa cepat barang-barang itu boleh dihantar?; (just) as ~ (do st), lebih suka: it’s so wet, I’d just as ~ stay in the office and get on with my work, hujan lebat betul, saya lebih suka duduk di pejabat dan meneruskan kerja; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : ~er than, lebih suka: I would ~er stay home tonight than go to the meeting, saya lebih suka duduk di rumah malam ini drpd menghadiri mesyuarat; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : as ~ as, sebaik(-baik) saja: he answered as ~ as I finished speaking, dia menjawab sebaik saja saya habis bercakap; as ~ as possible, secepat mungkin; ~er or later, lambat-laun: it’s got to be done ~er or later so we might as well do it now, lambat-laun terpaksa dibuat juga, lebih baik kita buat sekarang; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : ~ after, tdk lama kemudian, tdk lama selepas itu; ~ ... than, lebih baik ... drpd: ~er death than defeat, lebih baik mati drpd kalah; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : 2. early, awal, cepat: the ~er the better, lebih cepat lebih baik; if you deliver the food too ~, we will not be able to store it, jika kamu menghantar makanan itu terlalu awal, kami tdk dapat menyimpannya; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : b. (in the past) tdk lama kemudian: the plane ~ took off, tdk lama kemudian, kapal terbang itu berlepas; he ~ fell asleep, tdk lama kemudian dia terlelap; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : adv 1. shortly, a. (in the future) tdk lama lagi; (in a very short time) sekejap lagi: it will ~ be winter, tdk lama lagi musim sejuk; “When will the soup be ready?” “S~, ” “Bila sup ini akan masak?” “Sekejap lagi”; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
